observational_status: single-diagnostic LIUQE equilibrium reconstruction numerical-quality audit; not experimental precursor timing, prospective or controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: CRC/SHA-verified LIUQE reconstruction geometry-quality mask completed across 321 frames x 61 surfaces (19,581 cells). All geometric cells finite, all 321 reconstruction convergence flags true. Interior centroids within L grid in 17,236/17,241 cells, edge in 855/855; extreme kappa and grid excursions disproportionately affect the near-axis region (116 of 1,485 centroids outside the grid).
interpretation: Descriptive numerical quality supports a largely grid-compatible interior/edge reconstruction while identifying unresolved near-axis anomalies despite converged flags. The rho regions are descriptive, not physically validated exclusion thresholds. Physical validity, units, absolute clock, cross-diagnostic synchronization, native M3D-C1 handoff and causal TCT effect remain unverified; TCT mechanism neutral/unmeasured.
followup_scope: One enabled, bounded near-axis singularity isolation audit: count kappa>10 and aminor<=1e-6 and out-of-grid centroids by region and frame, without treating descriptive cutoffs as physical validation or modifying frozen gates.
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, alpha, recirculation, radiation, rotation, conversion, lithium, ignition or net-power validation
m3dc1_claim_boundary: No native M3D-C1 run, zero/handoff equivalence or mapped experimental actuator. Frozen +0.020% width and +0.10% Jpk gates unchanged and inapplicable to this reconstruction audit.
